BOZ64 for Linux (portable)

1. Copy everything inside the "data" folder of BOZ64 PC (the Windows version) into a folder named "data" here,
   next to the boz64 program. (Without it, BOZ64 uses ~/.local/share/BOZ64/data instead and says so on start.)
2. Run ./boz64

Needs OpenGL ES 2 through EGL (Mesa, or the NVIDIA driver), which every desktop Linux has.
Saves, settings, boz64.log, boz64.props and peers.txt live in the same folder as data/.
